text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The clinical presentation of sudden, brief (3-minute) vertigo triggered by changing positions, accompanied by nausea but no hearing loss or focal neurologic deficits, is classic for BPPV.
